newsitem.title: LEBANON: Two Lebanese killed during Sierra Leone coup.
newsitem.headline: Two Lebanese killed during Sierra Leone coup.

text.p: Lebanon said on Monday that two Lebanese were killed and two wounded in Sierra Leone when armed forces seized power in the West African country on Sunday.

"After the coup d'etat in Sierra Leone we were informed that Hassan Said and Walid Roumieh were killed and two other Lebanese nationals were wounded in the chaos in Freetown," Foreign Minister Faris Bouez told reporters.
Bouez said many of the 2,000 Lebanese living in the country, most of whom are businessmen, took shelter at the Lebanese embassy in Freetown.

"They suffer from shortages of water and food," he added. "We are making contacts, mainly with the British and French embassies in Freetown, to evacuate the Lebanese community or to move them to safer areas."
